::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** June 14 1895  
**Manuscript:** Copy outletter book, Hampshire Record Office 70M92W/59/156
:::

Dear Madam
I enclose the deed for [Mrs. Yonge](people/person_1604.qmd)’s signature in one place only where you will see her name written in pencil. [^1]  This signature should be made in the presence of a witness who will sign where shewn adding address & occupation, a householder is best, but a servant will do.  <u>You</u> must not, of course, be the witness.  Please leave the date blank & return me the deed as soon as possible as it has to be stamped &c.

I am yours faithy
[Chas Wooldridge](people/person_2094.qmd)

Miss Yonge
70 Kensington Gardens Square

---

[^1]: The deed transferring the insurance policy on Frances Yonge’s life to CMY.
